ABOUT US

Progress, people, and practical coverage have shaped Motive from day one.

Get Your Quote
Progress. Our foundation since day one.

Motive Insurance supports customers on the road, in the home, and in business with coverage conversations built around real needs.

Moving forward and living fully

Our team helps customers understand coverage options, identify gaps, and protect the work and property that matter most.

People who risk, learn, and grow

Motive people are dedicated to making insurance easier for customers and communities through practical guidance and responsive service.

Who is your better trusted agent?

A trusted agent helps compare options, explain coverage, and support customers when policies, claims, or documents need attention.
